annotations.title: Read ad spend caps and headroom

description:
[read-only] The brand's activation spend caps and what is committed against them this month, the owner's agent ceilings, and the ad account spending limit with what is left of it (all in cents). Pass campaignId to learn what ads_campaign_approve with activate: true would answer right now: `applied` (it switches on), `approval_requested` (the owner gets an approval request) or `refused` with the reason. Read it before activating, and tell the user which one to expect. It covers flayr's own checks; the ad network can still refuse.
(Wraps GET /api/v2/ads/caps.)

brandId.description: A brand id (GET /api/v2/brands) or "personal"; default: the key owner's active brand.

campaignId.description: A campaign id (GET /api/v2/ads/campaigns) to forecast the activation of.

name: ads_caps_get
title: Read ad spend caps and headroom
